//: Only what the emulator and the rules deploy need. The app itself is Cloud Run, not Firebase Hosting — see infra/deploy-web.sh.

storage.//: Evidence media, avatars and uploaded paper forms. There were no storage rules at all until 2026-08-20, while storageBucket was already configured — the default posture must not be discovered on the day the first photograph is uploaded.
storage.//bucket: The bucket these rules govern: the one bootstrap.sh makes, ${PROJECT}-evidence. Named because this project has no DEFAULT bucket — Firebase Storage was never 'Get Started'-ed here, and the evidence bucket was made with gcloud and registered afterwards. Change it when the project changes.
storage.//deploy: NAMING IT IS NOT ENOUGH TO DEPLOY IT. `firebase deploy --only storage` fails here with 'Firebase Storage has not been set up on project' whatever this file says, because the CLI checks for a default bucket BEFORE it reads any of this — and there is none, though the evidence bucket is registered and its rules release exists. So storage rules are published against the Rules API directly, by PUTting a ruleset and pointing projects/${PROJECT}/releases/firebase.storage/${BUCKET} at it. Firestore deploys normally: `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules`. Run both from a shell with GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS UNSET, or the CLI authenticates as warrant-web, which may not write rules.
